source: QF-20260904-619 -- measured post-fix (schema-reference-snapshot.mjs array_agg(a.attname::text) cast) full sweep via schema-reference-lint.mjs --all --json
fix: array_agg(a.attname) returned raw Postgres array-literal TEXT (name[] OID has no node-postgres array parser) instead of a JS array, turning findViolations cols.includes(ref.column) into a substring test instead of exact membership. Cast to ::text (text[] OID IS parsed) fixes it at the source.
note: This measured list SUPERSEDES the originating RCA a4481013 estimate of 33 refs / 18 tables -- that estimate predated this fix and was scoped narrower than this full --all sweep. Follow-up triage SD should be minted from THIS list.
